text:
maria: quick heads-up  canary kernel-selector change -> host parse p50 jumped 2.2x on small streaming workload. Repro and flame below.

maria: repro:
```
./harness --mode=stream --seq-len=64 --chunk=64 --concurrency=40 --target=canary-host:8080
```
observed: parse p50 6.4ms (was 2.8ms), pod CPU +70%.

maria: sampled flame (10s):
- 34% host.parse.tokenize
- 22% host.stream.frame_parse
- 18% kvcache.evict
- 9% grpc.writev
- 7% net.write
pprof: https://perf.internal/pprofiles/1811112222

ryan: interesting. any code touching key generation or batching recently?

ash: kernel-selector reduced mini_batch_hint on canary. smaller mini-batches -> more flushes.

kai: traces show kvcache miss canary ~43% vs prod ~12%. Keys differ by header byte-order (we started canonicalizing headers).

lee: if order changed, identical requests produce different keys -> cold inserts/evicts.

maria: sample key diff (short):
old: ..len:72..hash:ab12
new: ..len:74..hash:ff3c  (extra 2 bytes from header order)

ash: hypothesis: mini-batch reduction + nondeterministic key bytes = amplified CPU and evict churn.

ryan: can we toggle selector to legacy?

maria: yes. KERNEL_HINT=legacy -> p50 parse 2.9ms, miss ~14%. strong signal.

lee: mitigation plan: 1) stable key serializer (sort headers) 2) enforce min_mini_batch=8 in selector. prioritize key serializer.

maria: I'll open PRs and run microbench. Drafts: kernel: https://git.redwood/infer/commit/abf1 (draft), kvcache-key: https://git.redwood/infer/commit/cd21 (draft).

perf-bot: perf alert created perf-1811112222. baseline p50 2.8ms -> canary 6.4ms. routed to #eng-runtime oncall.

ash: add small-chunk streaming microbench to CI. kai: add telemetry rule for kvcache miss% >20% over 5m.

maria: will post before/after pprofs here once PRs land. Thanks.
